name: Beige adipocyte
short_description: In-between form: lives in white fat depots but can be switched on by cold or exercise to a heat-producing state ('browning'). Responds to irisin (from muscle) and noradrenaline. A therapeutic target against obesity.

reference.theme: real (light micrograph (H&E, subcutaneous WAT, 6C cold exposure - beige/multilocular cells interspersed among unilocular white adipocytes))
